knowledge_claims.claim: The period generated 397 A/B leads and 58 Tier A leads.
knowledge_claims.interpretation: Because A/B density stays near 30 percent while volume grows, scaling improved absolute qualified volume but not quality density.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: No CRM revenue validation is available.

knowledge_claims.claim: Intent signals separate high-quality and low-quality leads.
knowledge_claims.interpretation: The evidence explains that explicit trip readiness, especially tickets and near travel windows, is materially more associated with A/B and Tier A quality.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: This is association, not causal proof.

knowledge_claims.claim: COMMERCIAL matched supports direct cost-quality reading.
knowledge_claims.interpretation: COMMERCIAL can be interpreted economically because the matched universe links spend and leads; ATTENTION and ACTIVATION are not equivalent decision layers.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Cross-layer KPI ranking is not allowed by the FARO profile.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: The concentration implies a practical testing focus, but it does not prove that creative content caused quality outcomes.

recommendations.hypothesis: A stricter ticket/travel-window intent emphasis will raise A/B density without collapsing commercial volume.
recommendations.action: Run a controlled commercial test that prioritizes ticket and near-window intent prompts.
recommendations.population: Meta Lead Ads commercial matched traffic.
recommendations.primary_metric: A/B lead rate and Tier A count in COMMERCIAL matched.
recommendations.guardrail: Do not reduce total qualified A/B volume below the current monthly baseline.
recommendations.expected_direction: Higher A/B density and stable qualified volume.
recommendations.success_criterion: A/B rate improves with no loss in Tier A count.
recommendations.evidence_dependency: Future BigQuery MCP evidence at the same grain.
recommendations.uncertainty: Association is observed; causal lift must be tested.
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: Stop if C/D share rises or commercial volume collapses.

recommendations.action: Keep ATTENTION, ACTIVATION and COMMERCIAL in separate reporting blocks.
recommendations.supporting_evidence: Spend_by_signal and commercial_matched evidence show non-equivalent FARO universes.
recommendations.verifiable_result: Reports contain no universal KPI ranking across FARO layers.
recommendations.closure_criterion: SPEC-017 and Presentation checks preserve layer separation.
recommendations.risk: Cross-layer ranking may overstate economic efficiency.
recommendations.dependency: FARO strategic context profile remains active.

recommendations.hypothesis: Some ad_id_norm clusters may carry reusable intent framing.
recommendations.missing_evidence: Controlled creative test or creative metadata.
recommendations.promotion_condition: Promote only after a future controlled experiment.

limitations: No revenue or CRM final outcome source.
